title: Zero-Cost Longitudinal Dataset Acquisition & Model Validation
summary: A compliant research-only five-league longitudinal dataset was built from 15 cached official CSVs: 5,256 completed fixtures, three seasons and zero duplicates. The unchanged TASK-054 baseline and a separate no-xG ablation were validated. Longitudinal sample sufficiency is resolved, but the best holdout result has negative ROI and unstable league/season behavior, so it is not a production candidate.
blockers: The research source cannot satisfy the frozen production 90% completeness contract.
The best no-xG model has negative OOS ROI and insufficient league/season stability.
next_action: Review the research-only PR. Keep production unchanged and continue separate zero-cost calibration and benchmark research.
